posture: official single-binary local server (its only posture; hosting is self-managed)

boot.ceremony: download binary, serve, create superuser, POST a collection with a file field

interrupt.resumeMechanism: none — a record create is a single multipart POST; there is no resumable protocol or upload session

bigUpload.bytesRetransmitted: full file re-sent (no resume surface); the aborted attempt’s bytes are additional

share.ttlMechanism: POST /api/files/token mints a short-lived file token (default ~3 min, configurable); public collections need no token at all
share.revocation: token TTL only; no per-URL revocation

deletion.referenceTracking: the file IS the record field — deleting the record deletes the file; no dangling ids by construction

geoPrivacy.note: unchanged ⇒ verbatim; PocketBase does thumbs for images only, nothing for video metadata

limits.docs: PocketBase: file field maxSize per field (200MB set here); single binary, local disk or S3-backed storage; no resumable protocol

cleanup.note: arm collection removed; pb_data is gitignored and local-only
